# 2 Baruch Chapter 64 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**64:1** "And-those-black-waters which-again-came and-darkened-those-bright: these-are-the-words-of-Manasseh, the-son-of-Hezekiah;"

**64:2** "for-he-did-much-evil, and-he-killed-the-righteous, and-he-bent-down-the-law, and-he-shed-innocent-blood, and-he-polluted-the-priests, and-he-defiled-the-altar-of-the-LORD."

**64:3** "And-he-brought-idols-into-the-temple-of-the-LORD, and-he-established-them in-the-temple, and-he-worshipped-them there."

**64:4** "And-he-burnt-incense-to-the-Baals in-the-valley-of-Hinnom; and-he-caused-his-children-to-pass-through-the-fire to-the-idol."

**64:5** "And-he-built-high-places in-Judah, and-he-filled-the-streets-of-Jerusalem-with-innocent-blood."

**64:6** "And-he-caused-Judah to-sin; and-he-sold-their-children-into-captivity; and-he-was-a-transgressor-of-the-law."

**64:7** "But-even-more-than-all-these, he-forsook-the-Holy-One, and-he-walked-in-the-ways-of-the-Gentiles."

**64:8** "These-are-the-fifth-black-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
